motions.description: Approve all items on the consent agenda including minutes, bills and vouchers for July 2025 totaling $3,330,693.31, license applications, resolutions, and ordinances.
Approve a proclamation for National Payroll Week, September 1st to 5th, submitted by Erin Moran, President of PayrollOrg.
Receive and file a recommendation from the Plan, Zoning and Development Committee to approve three applications submitted by the Village of Elmwood Park for municipal and public parking lots.
Receive and file a recommendation from the Traffic and Safety Committee Chairman Mike Kersch for a new stop sign installation.
Approve an Ordinance granting a Special Use Permit for the construction of a governmental use parking lot upon the Village-owned property located at 7415-7417 W. Fullerton Avenue.
Approve an Ordinance granting a Special Use Permit for the construction of a governmental use public parking lot upon the Village-owned property located at 1614 N. 73rd Avenue.

Authorize an Ordinance to approve a Map Amendment rezoning the Village-owned property at 1612 North 77th Avenue to B-2 General Business District and granting a Special Use Permit for the construction of a public parking lot at said location.
Approve a recommendation from the Traffic and Safety Commission to install a Stop sign on 74th Avenue at Wrightwood on the west side of 74th Avenue.
Approve a resolution honoring Michael K. Durkin on his induction into the University of Illinois Division of Intercollegiate Athletics Hall of Fame Class of 2025.
